VEP.name: TriggerChannel
VEP.tooltip: ActiCHamp input the trigger cable is plugged into, counted over all amplifier inputs: 1-32 are the EEG inputs, 33 = AUX 1, 34 = AUX 2, and so on. It does not depend on how many EEG channels you record: trigger in AUX 1 -> enter 33. This is not the column number in the saved file (there the trigger follows the recorded EEG channels). VEP: always 33 - plug the photodiode into AUX 1; any other value is replaced by 33.
